| 2    | 7.8               | \(7.8 \times 3141.59 \approx 24504.42\) | \(24.50\) |

So, each cone has a volume of **3141.59 cm³**.  
The first cone (density 5.2 g/cm³) weighs about **16.34 kg** (≈ 16 336 g).
